Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

We're a team of 170+ across 26 states and 7 countries, headquartered in New York City. 

Lithic's Treasury Operations team owns the movement of money across our card issuing infrastructure - network settlement, sponsor bank transfers, and the reconciliation that keeps it all provable. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who wants to learn the inner workings of payments and fintech infrastructure, not just observe them from a reporting layer.

• Operate in a time-sensitive environment where errors or delays have immediate downstream consequences

• Support reconciliation and ensure transfers tie out against expected activity

• Be a reliable, detail-oriented operator of an existing process - accuracy and consistency matter as much as speed

Project Support (30%)

Ongoing

You'll come out of this role with a depth of operational fintech knowledge that's hard to get anywhere else.

About us    

Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology.  Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.

Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward.  Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving.

Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!  

The role

At Wayve, you'll help deliver the value of our breakthrough autonomous-driving technology by ensuring that a core part of our it - the AI model - is released reliably, on time, and to the standard required for production.

As our Model Release Manager, you'll own how new AI models move through the full lifecycle - from hypothesis, through training, evaluation, and on-road testing, to deployment across our vehicle fleet - balancing the fast-paced, non-deterministic nature of ML with structure and disciplined release practices.

We're looking for someone pragmatic, methodical, and system-minded - someone who understands how model releases fit into the broader engineering, evaluation, and product ecosystem, and who introduces the processes and systems needed to achieve stability, clarity, and business goals. This role rewards two things together: strong release-engineering instincts, and the judgment to know where a non-deterministic, hypothesis-driven system breaks those instincts and where it doesn't. If you have the first and are hungry to build the second fast, this is worth a conversation.

Key responsibilities:

• Model release planning & coordination: Own the model release cycle, maintaining a steady and predictable cadence for shipping new models while adapting to business priorities.

• Gating & promotion: Define and run the gates that promote a model from hypothesis → training → evaluation → validation → deployment. Define and justify the promotion criteria that determine what ships and what is deferred - balancing performance gains, reproducibility, product requirements, safety, and integration compatibility with the onboard software stack and vehicle platform.

• Issues management: Drive investigations and follow-up actions on regressions, integration issues, and technical debt; manage rollback/roll-forward of model versions.

• Bottleneck identification & improvement: Identify constraints in the model-release process and drive improvements. Implement dashboards and KPIs for visibility, and proactively escalate gaps.

• Process & systems building: Understand how model releases fit into the wider system of model development, evaluation, Wayve onboard stack, and product; build processes and frameworks that support clarity, stability, and business goals.

• Tooling & automation influence: Partner with ML platform and integration teams to shape end-to-end automated release tooling; define requirements that improve developer experience, release efficiency, and stakeholder communication.

• Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with ML engineering, evaluation and data science, software platform, testing, and product teams to ensure successful and stable model releases.

• Clarity & communication: Act as the central point of contact for model-release status, risks, and timelines, keeping stakeholders informed at the right level of detail.

Which product you'll own
We run four consumer products and we are hiring product managers for all of them.
Galatea - serialized fiction, millions of readers, coins and subscription
CandyJar - the #1 US-based microdrama platform, billions of episodes streamed
Ironblood - our new AI-native streaming platform for action and adventure

We decide which one you own at the point you start, not at the point you apply. When you join, we look at where the largest metric gap is across the portfolio and put you there. As the team grows, areas get reshuffled - people move to where the biggest problem is.
We are telling you this up front because it is a real feature of working here, and because it does not suit everyone. If you want to own one named surface for three years, this is the wrong company. Some of our strongest product managers were hired for one thing and were doing something else entirely within a year - including one who was brought in to build internal tooling and ended up launching CandyJar from zero.
 
How We Work - please read this part carefully
This role works differently from most product jobs, and the difference matters more than anything else on this page.
Ali, our founder and CEO, sets company priorities. You own the ideas. You will own an app or area end to end, and you will spend part of every day researching competitors, the industry and our users to generate new feature ideas. Every product manager here keeps a live Top 3 list of the highest-impact ideas for their area - a new idea only enters that list by beating one already on it.
You pitch ideas to Ali on a single slide with a rough impact calculation attached. He rejects the ones that will not move the number enough to justify building them. That happens often, to everyone, and it is not a signal that anything has gone wrong.
Once an idea is approved, you own execution: spec, design, engineering, launch, and the A/B test. You release and ramp tests on your own judgement. Four weeks after launch, every feature is reviewed against the impact you predicted before you built it.
Your performance is measured on exactly two things: how often you beat your own Top 3, and the realised impact of what you ship.

This role is ideal if you want to learn outbound sales properly, build real commercial skills, and progress over time into broader Used and New Car Advertising roles.

• Interrogate denial codes, identify root causes, and correct/resubmit claims immediately.

• Draft and submit comprehensive appeal packages complete with supporting clinical documentation.

• Track authorization requests, maintain current expiration dates in patient records, and handle auth-related appeal escalations (especially critical for weight-loss medications).

5. Administrative & Communication Support

• Monitor incoming electronic faxes for payer determinations, authorization approvals, and claim correspondence; route and document all paperwork within eClinicalWorks.

• Utilize our Telzio VOIP phone system to handle inbound and outbound billing calls with payers and patients.

Experience: Minimum of 3+ years of hands-on, full-cycle U.S. medical billing and RCM experience.

Specialty Expertise: Billing experience in Internal Medicine , Pediatrics , or specialized Obesity Medicine / Weight Management / Nutrition practices.
